synopsis.text:
Far away in peaceful Angel Land lived a young angel warrior named Pit, who has been given the task of defeating the monstrous Medusa, who wishes to destroy Angel Land and all of the people, and she has started by kidnapping Palutena, the Princess of Angel Land.

Young Pit must rescue the Princess and restore peace to Angel Land. He will travel from the deep caverns of the Underworld to Medusa's palace in the sky on his journey, and deadly monsters will attack him every step of the way. But he has the power of the Gods on his side! A powerful bow and arrows, Water of Life, and Angel Feathers will assist Pit on his quest to destroy Medusa and save the princess!

Kid Icarus is a platform game where the player goes through several vertically outlaid levels, shooting enemies with his bow on the way and collecting hearts they leave behind. Pit's bow can shoot both forward and upwards. As Pit continues upwards, more and more of the level ends up beyond the bottom of the screen and if Pit falls down out of the screen, he dies. 

The levels contain doors which lead to chambers of various types - some chambers are filled with enemies, some are treasuries which allow Pit to obtain a power-up, some are stores where Pit can buy stuff, some will replenish his health, in some Pit will be able to take a test in hopes of getting a powerful weapon, and finally some chambers give Pit a chance of receiving a strength upgrade, therefore increasing the amount of damage his attacks deal. 

Pit earns experience as he defeats enemies, and he gains levels from this experience. The more levels Pit has, the more maximum health he has. 

Hearts taken from enemies are used in shops to buy various items and power-ups. Items include a protective shield which harms enemies, a more powerful bow, a mallet which allows you to smash the poor Palutena's warriors turned to stone who will later help you to fight a boss, a torch to see yourself in dark areas and others.

Une aventure passionnante de la mythologie  grecque.
Dans le royaume lointain du "Domaine des Anges", la méchante Medusa a volé les Trois Trésors Sacrés et emprisonné la déesse de la lumière, Palutena. En tant que Kid Icarus, votre mission consiste à trouver les trésors, détruire Medusa et libérer Palutena. Amassez des armes et de l'énergie tout en voyageant parmi les ruines au cours de votre mission destinée à vaincre Medusa et son armée et à secourir Palutena ainsi que les trésors du Palais Céleste. Si vous y parvenez, vous serez le héros du "Domaine des Anges". Pouvez-vous réussir?

Weit weg im friedlichen Land der Engel lebte ein junger Engelskrieger namens Pit, der die Aufgabe erhielt, die monströse Medusa zu besiegen, die das Land der Engel und alle Menschen zerstören will, und sie begann mit der Entführung von Palutena, der Prinzessin der Engel. Erde.

Der junge Pit muss die Prinzessin retten und den Frieden im Land der Engel wiederherstellen. Auf seiner Reise von den tiefen Höhlen der Unterwelt zu Medusas Palast im Himmel wird er von tödlichen Monstern auf Schritt und Tritt angegriffen. Aber er hat die Macht der Götter auf seiner Seite! Ein mächtiger Pfeil und Bogen, Wasser des Lebens und Engelsfedern helfen Pit bei seiner Mission, Medusa zu vernichten und die Prinzessin zu retten!

En un tiempo en el que hombres y dioses convivían en armonía, el reino de la Tierra del Ángel estaba gobernado por dos diosas, Palutena, la Diosa de la Luz y Medusa, la Diosa de la Oscuridad. Mientras Palutena administraba la luz y ayudaba a los mortales a cultivar la tierra, Medusa menospreciaba a los hombres y usaba la oscuridad para destruir sus cosechas y convertirlos en piedra. Enfurecida, Palutena transformó a Medusa en un horrible monstruo y la desterró al oscuro Inframundo.

Un'emozionante avventura della mitologia greca.
Nel lontano regno del "Dominio degli Angeli", la malvagia Medusa ha rubato i Tre Sacri Tesori e imprigionato la Dea della Luce, Palutena. Nei panni di Kid Icarus, la tua missione è trovare i tesori, distruggere Medusa e liberare Palutena. Raccogli armi ed energia mentre viaggi tra le rovine in missione per sconfiggere Medusa e il suo esercito e salvare Palutena e i tesori del Palazzo Celeste. Se ci riuscirai, sarai l'eroe del "Dominio degli angeli". Te la senti?

Longe, na pacífica Terra dos Anjos, vivia um jovem guerreiro anjo chamado Pit, que recebeu a tarefa de derrotar a monstruosa Medusa, que deseja destruir a Terra dos Anjos e todas as pessoas, e ela começou sequestrando Palutena, a Princesa dos Anjos. Terra.

Young Pit deve resgatar a princesa e restaurar a paz na Terra dos Anjos. Ele viajará das cavernas profundas do submundo ao palácio de Medusa no céu em sua jornada, e monstros mortais o atacarão a cada passo do caminho. Mas ele tem o poder dos deuses ao seu lado! Um poderoso arco e flecha, Water of Life e Angel Feathers ajudarão Pit em sua missão de destruir Medusa e salvar a princesa!
